svg.title: AI needs engineering context
svg.desc: Given only the sentence 'allow customers to update their delivery address', an AI agent must assume answers about shipping status, payment, verification, notifications, API standards and security. With stories, documentation, architecture standards, API contracts, domain models and the codebase flowing through an access-controlled context layer into a living specification, it can surface a plan, gaps and conflicts before code is written.
